Record rule.description: A record rule: a true or false test on the fields of one record
body: // Record rule: true when the record is valid.

body: // Field rule: \$ is the value of the field.

Query.description: A pipeline query: FROM, WHERE and SELECT

Switch.description: A switch expression with a default case

Loop over a collection.description: A loop over the items of a collection

Loop over a range.description: A loop over a range of numbers
